description: Implementation of the CoalescingCertVerifier class, which manages batching of certificate verification requests to optimize performance and resource usage. Contains classes for Job and Request handling, with detailed lifetime and request management logic.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::Job
classes.description: Represents a single verification job that batches multiple requests to the underlying verifier, managing their lifecycle and completion.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::Request
classes.description: Represents an individual verification request attached to a Job, handling completion and cancellation.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::Verify
methods.description: Initiates a certificate verification request, batching with existing requests if possible.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::SetConfig
methods.description: Updates the verifier configuration and invalidates current jobs.

methods.name: CoalescingCertVerifier::AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to monitor verifier changes.
